positive_snippets: I had such a nice stay at the Bizzotel hotel in Gurugram. The services were superb from service providers. It was a nice moment and I will be a good ambassador in Tanzania when I go back home. I am thankful to the service team lead by Dharam, Dev, Hemraj, Amar and Ramu.

I am Mtabazi Sahini from Tanzania. I had a pleasant stay at the hotel. Excellent service, friendly staff, good food, strong internet.
It was nice meeting MR.DHARAM DEV BHATTRAI

I had a wonderful stay at Hotel Bizzotel in Gurgaon. The hospitality was truly top-notch, and the staff were incredibly well-disciplined, polite, and attentive throughout my visit . The hotel is very clean and well-maintained, reflecting their commitment to hygiene and guest comfort.
One of the best features was their 24-hour restaurant service—very convenient and the food was delicious every time.Highly recommend this hotel for anyone visiting Gurgaon and looking for a pleasant and hassle-free stay!
